programme.title: The Jacket
programme.desc: Un soldat amnésique, accusé de meurtre, subit une étrange expérience à l'hôpital. Plongé dans une camisole, il voyage dans le temps, découvre son passé et un futur possible… Mais il ne lui reste que quatre jours pour changer le cours des choses.

programme.title: Le Monde de John
programme.desc: John, 13 ans, ressemble à tous les ados de son âge : élève moyen, il aime jouer aux jeux vidéo. En famille aussi, il se sent bien. Un jour, il découvre, par hasard, au fond de son jardin, un vieux bunker. Contre toute attente, il décide d'y enfermer sa soeur et ses parents après les avoir drogués.

programme.title: Comment Savoir
programme.desc: Lisa ne vivait que pour sa passion du sport et du softball, mais sa soudaine exclusion de son club la laisse complètement désemparée. C'est alors qu'elle fait la connaissance de Matty, un joueur de baseball professionnel, séducteur invétéré plutôt nombriliste...

programme.title: Frangins Malgré Eux
programme.desc: A 39 ans, Brennan Huff n'a toujours pas de vrai boulot et vit chez sa mère Nancy. Dale Doback est un éternel chômeur de 40 ans qui vit chez son père Robert.

programme.title: Les Z'intrus
programme.desc: Un ado réalise sa destinée en menant frère, sœur et cousins dans une bataille contre des extraterrestres qui utilisent leur maison de vacances pour planifier une invasion.

programme.title: Labyrinthus
programme.desc: Frikke, un garçon de 14 ans, découvre un jeu informatique sinistre qui utilise de vrais enfants de son quartier comme joueurs. Dans une course contre la montre, Frikke doit trouver le méchant créateur de cet horrible jeu.

programme.title: Rex, chien pompier
programme.desc: Le chien le plus choyé d'Hollywood s'égare lors d'un tournage publicitaire et devient la mascotte d'une caserne de pompiers locale.

programme.title: Votre programme reprendra rapidement
programme.desc: Nous nous refaisons une beauté ! Restez à l'écoute pour d'autres divertissements inestimables sélectionnés par Rakuten TV.

programme.title: Le voyage de Magellan
programme.desc: L'histoire de l'une des aventures les plus incroyables jamais vécues : le premier tour du monde.

programme.title: Wild Horses
programme.desc: Adela revient dans la famille avec l'offre d'un nouveau départ, ce qui rend Misko très heureux. Mario avoue son amour à Hana, qui le décline. Un enquêteur s'intéresse à Albert. Simon commence à avoir des doutes quant aux plans pour la ferme. Mario ne supporte pas le refus d'Hana.

programme.title: Yoko et pirate, duo de choc contre filous
programme.desc: Pendant les vacances de Noël, Yoko et Pirate s'échappent d'un hôtel pour animaux et transforment la maison en paradis canin, jusqu'à l'arrivée de cambrioleurs.

programme.title: Super-Vilains : La ligue des anti-héros
programme.desc: Dans un monde plein de super-vilains, de plans diaboliques et de domination mondiale, quelqu'un doit bien sortir les poubelles. Bienvenue dans le monde des Sbires de troisième classe. Lorsqu'une nouvelle recrue rejoint l'Union du Mal, elle est affectée à une équipe dirigée par Hank, un homme de main déchu. Mais lorsque le Kid vole accidentellement l'arme ultime du super-vilain, Hank doit briser son code du risque zéro pour sauver le garçon avec lequel il s'est lié d'amitié, même si cela signifie devenir la chose qu'il a toujours évité d'être : un héros.

programme.title: L'Avenir du ranch
programme.desc: Michael Thompson est comptable dans une grande ville et élève seul sa fille adolescente, Chloe. Une famille propriétaire d'un ranch en pleine campagne l'appelle à la rescousse. Leurs affaires sont au bord de la ruine, et ils espèrent garder le ranch avec l'aide de Michael. Ce dernier profite de l'occasion pour emmener sa fille avec lui.

programme.title: Step Dogs : À la poursuite du diamant polaire
programme.desc: Lorsque son père, Rick, fermier, se marie avec une star de cinéma Sabrina, Josh (10 ans) se retrouve avec une demie-soeur, Lacey (14 ans). Josh est un garçon introverti et Lacey est une enfant gâtée d'Hollywood. Les deux enfants ne s'entendent pas. Rick et Sabrina partent en lune de miel laissant les enfants seuls. Des cambrioleurs en profitent pour tenter de pénétrer dans la maison.

programme.title: La maison au bout de la rue
programme.desc: Elissa et sa mère emménagent près d'une maison marquée par un massacre. En se liant avec le fils survivant, Elissa découvre que le drame n'est pas fini.

programme.title: Golem, le tueur de Londres
programme.desc: Osmund, un jeune moine, aime une femme. Pour la retrouver, il guide des chevaliers vers un village isolé afin d'éliminer la source du mal qui l'a envahi.

programme.title: Le projet Atticus
programme.desc: Fondé en 1976 par le Dr Henry West, l'Institut Atticus étudiait des capacités paranormales : parapsychologie, voyance... Des centaines de cas ont été étudiés, mais rien ne préparait l'équipe à Judith.

programme.title: Les évadés de Santiago
programme.desc: Le récit haletant de l'une des plus grandes évasions carcérales de l'Histoire, celle de 49 prisonniers politiques chiliens au crépuscule de la dictature d'Augusto Pinochet.

programme.title: Le printemps
programme.desc: Un sanctuaire au plus profond de la forêt. Des masques attendent, se préparent. La musique demarre... On amène une cage. A l'intérieur, attachée, la victime. La fête peut commencer, une joyeuse célébration du retour du printemps.

programme.title: Port Bou
programme.desc: Un père emprunte le sentier des résistants avec son fils blessé sur son dos. Il traverse la frontière franco-espagnole en espérant le soigner à Port Bou.

programme.title: Pornography
programme.desc: Qu'est-ce que la pornographie ? Pourquoi est-il plus immoral de montrer des actes sexuels plutôt que des meurtres ? Qu'est-ce que la transgression ou l'indécence ? Et qu'en est-il de l'obscénité ? Faut-il limiter la liberté d'expression ?

programme.title: Marseille la nuit
programme.desc: Elias et Teddy ont toujours été amis. À vingt cinq ans, ils traînent, dealent et s'imaginent les rois de leur tout petit monde. Et puis, c'est sûr ils quitteront Limoges pour Marseille et deviendront des hommes. Leur rencontre avec Mona va précipiter les choses.

programme.title: RER B
programme.desc: Benoît Peyruck regarde et peint.

programme.title: Danielle Arbid
programme.desc: Portrait de la cinéaste Franco-libanaise Danielle Arbid. Du tournage de son quatrième long métrage "Peur de rien", à la préparation de son prochain film. Entre Beyrouth et Paris. Ses confessions, son quotidien. Portrait intime de l'artiste rageuse, sensuelle et engagée. L'intime et le travail.

programme.title: Le rêveur et les truands
programme.desc: 2 voyous attendent dans une vieille Lada, au milieu d'une rue déserte. Leurs complices ont braqué un fourgon blindé et se sont cachés dans les égouts. Les 2 hommes, chargés de les récupérer en voiture, ont la tache la plus simple : attendre...

programme.title: Chat
programme.desc: Bien qu'adulte, Emma vient de découvrir ce que ce mot veut dire. Elle va maintenant apprendre à le représenter avec l'aide d'autres personnes en situations de handicap comme elle, et le support d'Elisabeth, l'éducatrice. Emma ne sait pas se livrer, mais est-elle celle qui freine le plus à dévoiler ses sentiments ?

programme.title: Chronique de la jungle
programme.desc: On l'appelle “Le Chat”. D'origine très modeste, Le Chat gagne sa vie dans le monde de la nuit, en dealant de la cocaïne. Pour obtenir de la drogue, il hypnotise des femmes et propose à des hommes riches mais frustrés, de les posséder, en échange de plusieurs grammes... Mais ce soir, il va croiser Diane, une prédatrice qui va l'affronter... et le faire vaciller.

programme.title: Magie noire
programme.desc: La lumière est en clair-obscur. Le plateau est nu. La salle est vide. Les couloirs sont déserts. Deux tziganes. Des vrais chanteurs. Deux histoires parallèles : la tzigane et les auditions des chanteurs. L'enchevêtrement des deux mondes à travers le chant de l'opéra. Un univers visuel et sonore. Peu importe ce que disent les paroles, c'est l'imaginaire qui commande.

programme.title: Othello
programme.desc: Abd Al Malik actualise le chef d'œuvre de Verdi en le situant de nos jours dans un contexte urbain. Le réalisateur a choisi d'écrire les courts dialogues dans des intertitres, des cartons empruntés au cinéma muet, la bande-son étant constituée de la musique de l'opéra de Verdi arrangée par Arnaud de Solignac.

programme.title: Le Graffiti
programme.desc: Stupeur dans la ville ce matin : un graffiti est apparu sur la façade d'un édifice historique ! Les principaux concernés par l'inscription, le Maire et le Docteur Robin, vont devoir s'expliquer…

programme.title: Revulshk !
programme.desc: On voit toute une série de personnages lire le journal. Un article les interpelle et ils décident de manifester, de protester à leur manière. "J'avance le coeur léger mais toujours le poing levé" Amel Bent

programme.title: Cléo
programme.desc: Rien de plus banal qu'un divorce, sauf quand aucun des parents ne demande la garde de l'enfant. Cléo, dix ans, va fuir ce qui lui semble insupportable. Le sentiment d'abandon est un puissant moteur d'evasion.

programme.title: Miscellanées
programme.desc: Le soir tombe sur les montagnes du Queyras. Un être étrange apparaît dans la forêt et plante une graine qui fait naître un arbre au feuillage magique. Quand le jour se lève, une des petites feuilles entame alors un voyage qui animera toute la vallée.

programme.title: Premiers contacts
programme.desc: Tahiti : 1767. Une jeune fille observe les premiers échanges entre sa communauté et des européens venus par bateau. Petit à petit, leur présence altère son quotidien.

programme.title: La Pastèque
programme.desc: Un après-midi d'été, deux soeurs se chamaillent pour partager équitablement une demi pastèque.

programme.title: Dormir
programme.desc: Dans un appartement en pleine nuit, tout le monde dort tranquillement, sauf une adolescente tenue éveillée par les multiples petits bruits qui l'entourent.

programme.title: Dimanche matin
programme.desc: Tous les dimanches matin, Ann, une petite fille de 7 ans, est obligée de se lever tôt pour aller à l'église avec sa famille. Mais ce dimanche, cela ne se passe pas tout à fait comme prévu.

programme.title: Bigoudis
programme.desc: Dans une maison de retraite, l'ouverture d'un petit salon de coiffure réveille la vitalité de ses pensionnaires.

programme.title: Basav ! Chante !
programme.desc: Pieds nus sur les routes, les tziganes avancent toujours malgré le froid et les corbeaux, une guitare à la main.

programme.title: L'odeur des Plumerias
programme.desc: Au Laos, une adolescente française rencontre un novice bouddhiste. Lors d'une soirée, ils se rejoignent au karaoké.

programme.title: L'homme aux oiseaux
programme.desc: Dans un village de montagne bloqué par la neige, les habitants attendent la venue de l'Homme aux oiseaux, qui annonce la fin de l'hiver.

programme.title: Clapotis
programme.desc: Un après-midi d'hiver à la piscine...

programme.title: Service magique
programme.desc: Krishna, jeune touriste indien, va enfin vivre une journée de rêve à Lynsdéland, le célèbre et merveilleux parc d'attraction!

programme.title: Pedigree
programme.desc: Comme tous les enfants de son âge, Elias, 8 ans, va passer le test de "visio-prostérité".

programme.title: Chandran's café
programme.desc: Bienvenue au Chandran's café, tenu par Mary et son époux Chandran... sur la Lune.

programme.title: American Ninja 5
programme.desc: Lorsque la fille d'un scientifique est kidnappée, American Ninja (David Bradley) tente de la retrouver, mais cette fois-ci, il fait équipe avec un jeune qu'il a formé aux techniques du ninja.

programme.title: Merlin Et La Guerre Des Dragons
programme.desc: Alors que la guerre gronde en Angleterre, un bébé né d'une princesse et d'un démon, est recueilli par Le Mage, un magicien aux pouvoirs extraordinaires qui est le seul à vouloir élever l'enfant. A mesure que les années passent, le vieux mage enseigne à Merlin et à un autre orphelin nommé Vendiger les rudiments de la magie.

programme.title: Yeti : Terreur en Montagne
programme.desc: Des amis partent à l'aventure dans la neige et tombent nez à nez avec une créature mortelle.

programme.title: Battle Drone
programme.desc: 6 mercenaires sont engagés par la CIA pour enlever l'héritier d'une république et éliminer un marchand d'armes à Moscou et reçoivent une autre mission à Tchernobyl où la trahison les attend.

programme.title: Le Seigneur Du Monde Perdu
programme.desc: Un avion de ligne s'écrase quelque part en Amazonie et se scinde en deux. Au milieu des débris, les survivants tentent de s'organiser en attendant les secours qui tardent à venir. Ils décident alors de retrouver l'autre moitié de l'avion, pensant y trouver un radio-émetteur. En chemin, certains indices laissent à penser qu'ils ne sont peut-être pas seuls dans la jungle.

programme.title: Oculus
programme.desc: L'histoire se concentre sur un meurtre ayant eu lieu deux ans plus tOt laissant deux enfants orphelins. Les autorités pensent que le frère est coupable alors que la sœur prétend que le meurtrier serait un miroir antique hanté. Plus tard, alors qu'ils sont innocentés et que le frère est prêt à passer à autre chose, sa sœur veut prouver une bonne fois pour toute que le miroir est responsable de la mort de leurs parents.

programme.title: How To Murder A Millionaire
programme.desc: Une femme riche est convaincue que son mari a l'intention de l'assassiner, ce qui donne lieu à une comédie d'erreurs de plus en plus trépidante.

programme.title: The Exception
programme.desc: Hollande, 1940. Brandt, un jeune officier allemand ambitieux et patriote, est envoyé malgré lui en Hollande auprès de Guillaume II, Kaiser en exil, pour assurer sa protection. Il se laisse séduire et tombe amoureux de Mieke une jeune juive hollandaise au service du Kaiser. Les SS découvrent que la résistance a réussi à infiltrer un agent dans le repaire du kaiser pour l'assassiner et déstabiliser le régime d'Hitler. Brandt doit découvrir son identité. Entre trahison et jeu d'espion, très vite, il va découvrir qu'il devra lui aussi choisir entre amour et devoir.

programme.title: Cette Femme La
programme.desc: Le meurtre d'une suicidée n'efface pas les regrets d'une femme flic endeuillée. Tous les quatre ans, le passé la rattrape. Tous les quatre ans, cette femme-là a très peur. Peur à en crever. Car dans ses rêves commence la réalité...

programme.title: À la recherche du bonheur
programme.desc: Amy, infiltrée dans la retraite de Paul, découvre un secret qui la force à choisir entre l'amour et carrière.

programme.title: Les secrets du lac
programme.desc: Jennifer Riley doit retourner dans la ville où elle a grandi pour aider sa sœur, accusée de meurtre.

programme.title: Romance écossaise
programme.desc: En Écosse, une écrivaine est prise pour une autre par un poète, déchirée entre vérité et amour.

programme.title: An American Werewolf in Londong
programme.desc: David Kessler et Jack Goodman partent visiter le nord de l'Angleterre. Une nuit, une bête les attaque, tuant Jack. Des semaines plus tard, Jack revient mettre David en garde : c'est un loup-garou qui les a attaqués, et il se trouve désormais être le dernier des loups-garous !

programme.title: P2
programme.desc: Tard le soir de Noël, une femme qui sort seule du travail est enlevée par un agent de sécurité psychopathe qui a une obsession pour elle. Sans personne pour l'aider dans un parking immense, elle ne pourra compter que sur elle-même pour s'échapper.

programme.title: Carnival of Souls
programme.desc: Inspiré de l'oeuvre culte d'Herk Hervey, un classique des années 60, ce film met en scène une femme qui après avoir survécu à un grave accident de voiture est “hantée” par un esprit malveillant issu du passé.

programme.title: Une femme de cran
programme.desc: Alyssa Milano est Patty Montanari, veuve et mère de famille déterminée vivant à Brooklyn. Elle trouve du travail auprès d'une famille de la mafia locale et tombe bientôt amoureuse d'un homme marié et ponte de la mafia (Jason Gedrick de DESPERATE HOUSEWIVES).

programme.title: Grace Is Gone
programme.desc: Après avoir appris que sa femme a été tuée en Irak, un homme emmène ses deux filles en voyage en Floride et s'arrête en route pour voir sa famille.

programme.title: Beyond the Edge
programme.desc: Une bande d'arnaqueurs talentueux dotés de superpouvoirs tente de dévaliser un énorme casino, mais c'est sans compter sur un mystérieux rival qui semble tous les surpasser…

programme.title: Crimes et pouvoir
programme.desc: La vie d'une femme se retrouve impliquée dans une énorme affaire de dissimulation militaire quand elle apprend que son mari n'est pas celui qu'il prétend être.

programme.title: Staying Alive
programme.desc: Cela fait cinq ans que le Staying Alive de Tony Manero fait toujours autant fureur. Il se approche maintenant nonchalamment de son plus grand défi : le produire sur la scène de Broadway.

programme.title: A Mothers Fury
programme.desc: Barbara O'Brien, une mère catholique irlandaise, voit sa vie basculer lorsque son fils, un étudiant de première année à l'université, est impliqué dans un tragique incident de bizutage.

programme.title: Le Secret des Kennedy
programme.desc: L'histoire de Ted Kennedy et de son accident de voiture en 1969 qui a coûté la vie à Mary Jo Kopechne.

programme.title: Gagarin : first in space
programme.desc: Le 12 avril 1961, le cosmonaute soviétique Youri Gagarine devient le premier homme à voyager dans l'espace.

programme.title: Écran Large Ep.7
programme.desc: Écran Large : actu ciné, séries, comics, jeux vidéo

programme.title: Écran Large Ep.8
programme.desc: Écran Large : actu ciné, séries, comics, jeux vidéo

programme.title: Écran Large Ep.6
programme.desc: Écran Large : actu ciné, séries, comics, jeux vidéo

programme.title: Mourir ou Survivre pour Wildcat
programme.desc: Une journaliste capturée au Moyen-Orient lutte contre son passé tout en cherchant à renverser ses ravisseurs.

programme.title: La Fille du Président
programme.desc: La fille du Président des Etats-Unis insiste pour suivre une scolarité normale, sans la surveillance des services secrets. Un agent se fait donc passer pour un étudiant afin de la protéger.

programme.title: Lucky girl
programme.desc: Ashley est la femme la plus chanceuse de New York. Mais sa chance s'intervertit bizarrement avec celle du jeune homme le plus malchanceux de la ville.

programme.title: La Mouette
programme.desc: Une tragicomédie se déroule lorsque amis et famille se réunissent dans une propriété à la campagne où chacun tombe amoureux de quelqu'un qui aime quelqu'un d'autre.

programme.title: For Love or Money
programme.desc: Mark a une vie de rêve : il est sur le point de devenir multimillionnaire et d'épouser son amour de jeunesse, Connie. Mais les choses ne sont parfaites qu'en surface : Mark découvre par hasard que Connie ne l'aime pas et compte juste voler sa fortune une fois le mariage prononcé.

programme.title: L'Histoire de l'Amour
programme.desc: The story of a long-lost book that mysteriously reappears and connects an old man searching for his son with a girl seeking a cure for her mother's loneliness.

programme.title: L'Édition de l'Amour
programme.desc: La rédactrice beauté d'un magazine féminin convainc un photographe prometteur de prétendre être son petit ami lorsque son ex se fiance avec une autre. Ensemble, ils devront collaborer pour redorer la réputation déclinante du magazine.

programme.title: Un Noël de Roman
programme.desc: La romancière cynique Dru Cassadine, connue pour ses histoires d'amour, cherche désespérément à percer après une série d'échecs. Poussée par des critiques brutales et la menace de son éditeur de la laisser tomber, elle n'a que quelques semaines pour écrire un best-seller.

programme.title: Not forgotten
programme.desc: Jack Bishop vit heureux avec sa femme et sa fille adorée dans une petite ville tranquille du Texas. Mais lorsque cette dernière est mystérieusement kidnappée, Jack comprend que son sombre passé le rattrape. Face à l'inefficacité du FBI, il devra s'associer au culte de la Santa Muerte afin de se donner les moyens de retrouver sa fille. Sa recherche désespérée l'entraînera au Mexique dans un tourbillon de rebondissements. Au final, il devra combattre ses propres démons s'il veut serrer dans ses bras celle qu'il aime le plus au monde.

programme.title: Le Casse-Coeur
programme.desc: En plein cambriolage dans une maison, harry rencontre daisy et décide de la sauver d'elle-même.

programme.title: The Ten
programme.desc: Une parodie en dix histoires courtes inspirées des dix commandements.

programme.title: L'Amour à la Carte
programme.desc: Une cheffe dynamique, célèbre pour la meilleure cuisine authentique du Sud-Ouest, tombe amoureuse de l'héritier improbable d'une chaîne de fast-food mexicain.

programme.title: The Neighbor
programme.desc: Un homme d'âge moyen, coincé dans un mariage stagnant, trouve sa vie bouleversée lorsqu'une jeune femme séduisante et son mari apparemment violent déménagent dans l'habitation d'à côté...

programme.title: Prof Poids Lourd
programme.desc: Ancien catcheur, Scott Voss est, à 42 ans, prof de biologie au collège. Lorsque des coupes budgétaires menacent d'annuler les cours de musique et de renvoyer le prof, Scott décide de rassembler des fonds en participant au noir à des combats d'arts martiaux. Tout le monde le prend d'abord pour un dingue - particulièrement Bella, l'infirmière de l'école - mais finalement, c'est auprès de toute l'école qu'il fait sensation…

programme.title: Un Ange Gardien Pour Tess
programme.desc: Doug, un agent des services secrets américains, est soulagé : il vient enfin de terminer sa mission au service de Tess Carlisle, la femme du précédent président des Etats-Unis.

programme.title: Témoin À Louer
programme.desc: Doug Harris a un vrai problème : le jeune homme, qui n'a pas une vie sociale très riche, est sur le point de se marier, mais n'a pas de témoin. Comme il ne lui reste que deux semaines pour en trouver un, il fait appel à Jimmy Callahan, patron d'une petite société qui se charge de fournir des entourages factices aux futurs mariés. Mais rien ne se passe comme prévu...

programme.title: Armed And Dangerous
programme.desc: John Candy et Eugene Levy sont plongés dans le monde de la sécurité privée dans la comédie d'action délirante, ARMED AND DANGEROUS. Malheureusement, ils vont souvent dans la mauvaise direction ! Lorsque Candy, un policier maladroit, et Levy, un avocat incompétent, perdent leur travail, ils se retrouvent à travailler ensemble à la Guard Dog Security Company. A la suite d'une formation approfondie dans l'utilisation des armes (pendant deux heures), ils sont prêts à s'y mettre. Mais même en tant qu'agents de sécurité, ils sont incompétents, et les magouilles ne cessent de se passer sous leur nez. Ils finissent par se rendre compte que les cambriolages ne sont pas fortuits et que leur compagnie est de mèche avec le président mafieux de leur syndicat (Robert Loggia, 'Jagged Edge'). Désireux d'appréhender les voyous, Candy et Levy les espionnent et une folle course poursuite transforme le vol d'un million de dollars en un carnaval fou ! Lorsque les choses se calment enfin, Candy et Levy, les deux pauvres apprentis policiers hilarants bien plus amusants lorsque qu'ils sont armés, sauvent la situation dans ARMED AND DANGEROUS.

programme.title: 21 Jump Street
programme.desc: Jenko et Schmidt quittent le lycée et s'engagent dans la police. A la suite de leur première arrestation ratée, les deux jeunes policiers sont convoqués par leur supérieur. Celui-ci leur annonce qu'ils sont mutés dans une cellule des années 80 récemment réactivée, l'unité «21 Jump Street». Dans une église désaffectée, Jenko et Schmidt rencontrent d'autres jeunes policiers. Tous ont été choisis pour infiltrer les milieux universitaires californiens en tant qu'étudiants. Leur objectif est de démanteler les réseaux de trafiquants de drogue. Ces recrues sont soumises à des règles précises : pas de relations avec les élèves et les enseignants, et pas d'achat d'alcool à leur place. Jenko et Schmidt tente de mener l'enquête, mais n'en font qu'à leur tête...

programme.title: La machine à démonter le temps
programme.desc: Préparez-vous à botter le passé avec "La machine à démonter le temps !" Les rires délirants éclatent lorsque quatre amis partagent une nuit folle à boire dans un jacuzzi de station de ski, pour se réveiller avec une gueule de bois atroce... en 1986.

programme.title: Hot Tub Time Machine 2
programme.desc: Les héros de La Machine à démonter le temps sont de retour pour une course effrenée et sulfureuse encore plus drôle que la première !

programme.title: Next Day Air
programme.desc: Lorsqu'un chauffeur-livreur livre par inadvertance un colis qui contient des briques de cocaïne cachées à la mauvaise adresse, cela déclenche une quête et une bataille désespérées pour la cocaïne entre le trafiquant furieux qui l'a envoyée

programme.title: Super Héros Movie
programme.desc: Un adolescent orphelin est mordu par une libellule radioactive, ce qui lui confère des pouvoirs surhumains dans cette parodie de films tels que "Spider-Man", "X-Men" et "Fantastic Four".

programme.title: L'ange et le mauvais garçon
programme.desc: Quirt Evans, un méchant tout court, est soigné et recherché par Penelope Worth, une jeune fille quaker. Il finit par devoir choisir entre son monde et celui dans lequel vit Pénélope.

programme.title: Les couleurs du désert
programme.desc: Deux hommes trouvent un bébé abandonné et se disputent la propriété de l'enfant, ce qui entraîne une rivalité à vie.

programme.title: Le retour de Billy the Kid
programme.desc: Billy the Kid tente de vivre en paix, sous un nouveau nom et dans une ville frontalière, mais il est approché par un prédicateur qui lui demande de l'aider à libérer la ville d'un homme impitoyable et de son tireur.

programme.title: Hercule contre les tyrans de Babylone
programme.desc: Le roi Shalmaneser, Assur et sa sœur sorcière Tanit, tyrans de Babylone, retiennent prisonniers des Hellènes, dont Esperia, reine d'Hellas. Hercule intervient pour la sauver, punir les tyrans cruels et libérer le peuple.

programme.title: Les Pirates du Mississipi
programme.desc: Un groupe de pirates menés par Kelly, un bandit habillé tout en noir, sème la terreur en s'en prenant aux habitants de Helena et aux bateaux postiers sur le Mississippi. Le shérif James Lively doit aller contre la méfiance des habitants mais aussi des Indiens. Mais avec l'aide des Cherokees, car les bandits se sont établis sur leurs terres, et de son adjoint Tom Quincy, il parvient à mettre fin à leurs méfaits.

programme.title: Dreamcatcher
programme.desc: Deux soeurs et leurs amis se retrouvent retranchées dans un tourbillon de violence de 48 heures après une expérience traumatisante lors d'un festival de musique underground.

programme.title: Autopsy
programme.desc: Une bande d'adolescents s'en donne à coeur joie lors de la fête du Mardi Gras. Sur le chemin du retour, ils frappent de plein fouet un homme apparu de nulle part. Ayant à peine le temps de constater les dégâts, une ambulance arrive sur les lieux. L'ambulancier offre aux jeunes de les embarquer, question de s'assurer qu'ils ne sont pas blessés suite à l'impact. Le groupe est donc transporté dans un vieil hôpital miteux où il est accueilli par une infirmière totalement déconnectée de la réalité. À mesure que les adolescents sont appelés pour être examinés, il devient clair qu'ils étaient beaucoup plus en sécurité à l'extérieur du bâtiment.

programme.title: Terror Experiment
programme.desc: Un terroriste déclenche une explosion qui fait basculer le bâtiment fédéral et libère un gaz toxique dans tout le système de ventilation. Son but : exposer l'arme de guerre biologique secrète du gouvernement, un virus mortel qui attaque instantanément le système surrénalien d'une personne, la poussant à devenir inhumainement agressive, avec une envie incontrôlable de s'entretuer.

programme.title: The Witch In The Window
programme.desc: Lorsque Simon, père divorcé, amène son fils de douze ans, Finn, dans une région rurale du Vermont pour aider à remettre en état une ancienne ferme, ils rencontrent l'esprit malin de Lydia, l'ancienne propriétaire, décédée bien que n'ayant jamais quitté les lieux.

programme.title: Lavalantula
programme.desc: Des araignées géantes cracheuses de feu jaillissent d'anciens volcans dans les montagnes de Santa Monica. Leur objectif : détruire Los Angeles et ses alentours.

programme.title: Bloody Sand
programme.desc: Lors d'une apocalypse zombie, une femme au passé trouble originaire de Las Vegas se retrouve acculée dans le désert avec un zombie solitaire et affamé à ses trousses.

programme.title: Dead Zone
programme.desc: Un professeur de lycée subit avec sa future femme un accident de voiture qui va bouleverser sa vie. Lorsqu'il se réveille d'un coma de cinq ans, il découvre qu'il peut prédire le sort d'une personne par un simple contact physique.

programme.title: Hautes Fréquences
programme.desc: Des gardes du corps sont déployés pour sauver une célébrité sur une île. À leur arrivée, le lieu semble désert et hanté par une présence maléfique.

programme.title: Phantom
programme.desc: Jake est assassiné par des voyous de quartier. Il revient sous une forme surnaturelle (Le Spectre) pour se venger.

programme.title: The Fountain
programme.desc: Se déroulant sur plus de mille ans et trois histoires en parallèle, ce film parle d'amour, de mort, de spiritualité, et de la fragilité de notre existence dans ce monde.

programme.desc: La chaine 100% science-fiction et fantastique. Zone réservée aux fans de films et séries SF : catastrophes, zombies, extraterrestres, paranormal, space opéras, vampires, mondes perdus et créatures mutantes sont au programme

Alors que la violence s'abat sur leur idyllique escapade en forêt, les deux femmes s'engagent dans une bataille psychologique, vicieuse et frénétique qui mettra à l'épreuve les limites mêmes de leur instinct de survie.

Héléna se transforme alors en véritable machine à tuer. Devenue incontrôlable, elle assassine son père adoptif, libère un groupe de Scanners enfermé dans un hôpital et met au point un plan machiavélique afin de réduire le monde en esclavage.

programme.title: Time Flies
programme.desc: We like to think we can control everything: changing the course of water, reclaiming land, replanting deserts – we constantly remodel the natural world to suit our needs. But there's one thing we can't control: the passing of time. However, we can change how we see things using cameras we can start to see the world in different time frames. Now we can see animals following the sun, mass movements of the changing seasons and even the vast impact of the changing weather. Watch what happens when time flies…

programme.title: Destination Wild

programme.title: Destination Wild

programme.title: Bavarian Forest
programme.desc: After an unusual mass reproduction of bark beetles in the nineties, thousands hectares of old spruce forest were destroyed. Soon after, a new, healthier forest started to grow – a new primeval forest. Within a few years, in place of the former monoculture, a diverse forest developed, rich in spruces, ashes, beech and fir trees. Naturally, this diversity has in turn attracted new animal and plant species. Even lynx and otters returned and made Bavaria their home again.

programme.title: The Südheide
programme.desc: Forests and fields, moors and heathland, shepherds and sheep - these are the symbols of an ostensibly unspoilt landscape that has inspired poets and painters alike for centuries. The secret of the almost 500 km² nature reserve Naturpark Südheide lies in its diversity: the origins of its soil, geology and topography can be traced back to the ice age. But the region between Hamburg and Hannover is anything but unspoilt. For centuries, it was synonymous with heathland farmers and formed as a North German cultivated landscape. This documentary tells of an almost unknown region, which has been strongly influenced by mankind for centuries, yet still remains diverse in its nature. Nature filmmaker Günter Goldmann presents the Lüneburg Heath to us with impressive behavioural observations of quarrelling black grouse, badgers in their subterranean burrows, the clashing of young wild boar and crane fledglings, who seek protection in the warm plumage of their parents. Aerial views present the region from a lofty perspective, while extreme HD slow motion images of black grouse, wild boar and roe deer provide insights into the world of the animal inhabitants in the heart of Lower Saxony.

programme.title: Wild Slovakia
programme.desc: Brown bears, wolves, lynx, eagles… where within the European Union are these carnivores still regular inhabitants? Where can you find mountainous regions that yet wait to be discovered by mass tourism?

programme.title: Under the Spell of Horses
programme.desc: Iceland, the island of longing in the North. The biggest volcanic island in the world is known for its grandiose landscape, for its geysers and glaciers. But it is even more famous for its horses. Icelandic horses are considered the liveliest horses in the whole of Europe with the greatest stamina. They tölt over mossy banks and lava rock unfazed by rivers, glaciers and scree slopes. In Nordic mythology the steed are never far behind the warriors. Where would Siefgried be without his horse Grani, or Odin without Sleipnir. Even the sun wouldn't rise or set if “awake early” and “very quick” weren't pulling their chariot. From the beginning of colonisation, the Icelanders had the kind of close relationship with their horses usually only seen among the horse-riding peoples of Central Asia. And something of this love for horses still exists today. Life without horses would be unthinkable for Haukur Goroarsson, too. The 34-year old lives with his family in Vatnsdalur, a fertile valley in the North four hours by car from the capital city, Reykjavik. For him Icelandic horses are “a sort of Viking on four legs”. The settlement of this inhospitable island on the Arctic Circle would not have been possible without the animals. The stone deserts in the country's interior are too vast to be crossed on foot.

programme.title: Under the Spell of Horses
programme.desc: Proud elegance, silky-shiny coats and a graceful, powerful physique – the supreme Marwari horses have been worshipped in India as magical creatures for thousands of years. People say they descended directly from the Gods, that once when the Gods were sitting round the fire, there was so much soot that one of the Gods had to cry. One of the tears from his right eye changed into a stallion, and one of his tears from the left eye produced a mare. Ever since, the people in Rajasthan have believed that horses are Gods. Maharaja – palaces, temples and citadels, women in colourful saris and men with bright turbans – the land of the Rajas, the king's sons, arouse fantasies reminiscent of One Thousand and One Nights. Lively trading and war-related incidents from the past have led to the emergence of a unique horse culture in the region: Marwaris are the proud horses of the Indian Rajas. Each year in November, the small, barren desert oasis of Pushkar is transformed into a place of pilgrimage for millions of Indians. Everybody who is anybody on the horse scene in Rajasthan - Maharajas, breeders and horse masters - meets at the Pushkar Mela, the turbulent market for over 50,000 horses and camels. Pushkar is the place where the legendary Marwaris are bought and sold.

programme.title: Under the Spell of Horses
programme.desc: Once a year the royal city of Meknes is transformed into an oriental camp. Two thousand curious onlookers gather round the square. More than five hundred riders are expected to take part in this major Fantasia, a warlike display of horsemanship. 56-year old Lachsen Slimani is also obsessed with riding games. He lives with his family on a remote highland plateau in the Middle Atlas. Lachsen is proud because his 18-year old son Mohammed wants to follow in his father's footsteps. For that he needs his own horse, so the tradition goes. Lachsen wants to fulfil this dream for his son. So, in order to get the money together for the horse, he takes off on an adventure and is travelling to Quarzazate, which is also called the Hollywood of the desert.

programme.title: Hummingbirds: Jewelled Messengers
programme.desc: Hummingbirds live at the limits of what is possible. They have the highest metabolism with a heart rate of 1,200 beats per minute of any vertebrate. Their wings beat 50 times a second. They can hover on the spot, and even fly backwards. To our eyes, they are just a blur. But with the aid of high-speed cameras we can slow down their hyperactive lives and look into their secret world.

programme.desc: Olivia, Stephanie, Andrea, Mia and Emma enter a science contest at school and win a trip on a luxury yacht but not everything goes as planned when they set out to sea. When Olivia, Stephanie, Andrea, Mia and Emma enter a school science contest and win a Dolphin sight-seeing trip, not everything goes to plan...As the girls set out to sea on a luxury yacht, misunderstandings and disagreements occur which become secondary when they discover a pod of dolphins in danger. The girls learn that they have to compromise and trust in each other if they are to save the dolphins and their trip out to sea...

programme.title: Rise Of The Snakes
programme.desc: The four Ninja are snapped out of their post-hero complacency when Lord Garmadon's young son Lloyd shows up and tries to pick up where his father left off. The Ninja dismiss him as a threat, but regret that choice after Lloyd wakes up the evil snake tribe. A prophecy is revealed that states a green ninja will ultimately defeat Lord Garmadon.

programme.title: Home
programme.desc: Back in training mode with the looming threat of Lloyd and the Hypnobrai, Zane wanders after a Falcon and lands himself in a heap of trouble. The rest of the Ninja leave the training dojo to help him and return to find that the snakes have burned it to the ground.

programme.title: Snakebit
programme.desc: Lloyd, having been kicked out of the Hynobrai snake tribe unlocks a second tribe – The Fangpyres – to help him regain control. The Ninja are busy setting up their new HQ that Zane discovered, but are called to duty when the Fangpyres attack the village where Jay's family lives.

programme.title: Never Trust A Snake
programme.desc: After the Fangpyres join forces with the Hypnobrai, Lloyd awakens Pythor – the last remaining snake of the Anacondrai tribe. Pythor lures Lloyd under his spell and steals a map from him that will show him where the remaining two snakes tribes dwell and Uncle Sensei saves Lloyd from doom.

programme.title: The Book Of Monsters, Part 1
programme.desc: When Jestro the Jester finds the Book of Monsters, chaos breaks loose in the Kingdom of Knighton. Can the newly graduated Knights from the Knights' Academy save the kingdom? It's final graduation fighting exams for the latest Knights from Knights' Academy. All our new Knights demonstrate their prowess: CLAY, AARON, AXL and LANCE. PRINCESS MACY get to join them, but her father doesn't want her to graduate. As part of the entertainment, MERLOK does an amazing magic trick. His act is followed by…JESTRO, the King's Jester. He's terrible (and he should know to never follow a better act.) Everyone laughed because he's a real joke....a total failure. While Jestro roams the halls fo the King's Castle, forlorn, he hears the BOOK OF MONSTERS calling to him from Merlok's library. The book talks Jestro into gathering as many books of spells as he can carry, but they're interrupted by...Clay! As Jestro quickly pages through the Book of Monsters to attack Clay, Merlok arrives. There's a battle in the library between Jestro and Merlok. Finally, the wizard summons up his most powerful spell in self-defence. BOOM! There's a big, magical explosion and when Clay forces his way back into the library, Merlok, Jestro and the magic books are...GONE!

programme.title: The Book Of Monsters, Part 2
programme.desc: Realizing they must defend the Kingdom from Jestro's monsters, the Knights try to organize but are despondent when they discover their best advisor – Merlok the Magician – has sacrificed himself to save them. When Jestro awakens, he's been blasted miles and miles away from the King's Castle by Merlok's explosive spell. And, it seems, all the books he was trying to steal have been scattered, too. The Book of Monsters broke Jestro' fall and now he can use the book to attack the people who laughed at him. Meanwhile, the King and his newly-trained Knights pick through the rubble of Merlok's library. They'll have to figure something out, because Jestro and his newly made magic monsters attack King's Castle! Clay organizes the Knights to defend the kingdom, but they've never worked together before. It takes all their training, plus the help of an old friend…MERLOK! Only now he's MERLOK 2.0. Ava has been piecing together what happened and discovering that the “ghost in the machine” she's been chasing is really Merlok in digital form. Now, he can use his magic digitally and he downloads just the right weapons to the struggling Knights! They finally foil Jestro's attack with Merlok's help and officially become NEXO KNIGHTS!

programme.title: The Power Of Merlok
programme.desc: When Jestro attacks a village on the far side of the Kingdom, the NEXO-Knights wonder how they'll get there. Then Macy remembers her dad has a royal RV…maybe they can “mod” that for their own, “knightly” use? Now the NEXO-Knights get rolling…in THE FORTREX, their own ROLLING CASTLE! This great new HQ, which houses Merlok 2.0 as an operating system, will be how the knights move around Knighton and protect it from Jestro and his monsters. Speaking of the evil jester, in this episode Jestro uses some newly-made monsters to attack a town far from the capitol where he thinks he's safe from the Knights' reach. We see two parallel stories here: the Knights training, learning more about digital magic and getting organized as a team and at the same time we see Jestro making monsters, trying to learn how his powers work and talking to the Book. In the end, the Knights roll up in their castle and defeat Jestro and his marauding monsters. Lance thinks he should be the leader because he's a snot. “Of course I'm the leader…I'm a Richmond.”

programme.title: The Knights Code
programme.desc: Jestro uses the Book of Chaos to unleash, um, chaos and attack the King's hover train to try and kidnap the royal party. Can the NEXO-Knights bring order out of the chaos and save the King? Jestro finds the Book of Chaos in the countryside and decides he must feed it to the book. The Book of Monsters actually tells Jestro NOT to feed it to him he tells Jestro he's not ready for that kind of power. But Jestro doesn't listen. Now the Book unleashes chaotic monsters and Jestro uses them to attack the King and his party who are on a business-related tour of the kingdom. When the NEXO-Knights show up to stop the monster attacks and realize that they must save King and Queen Halbert – Macy's parents – from the chaotic evil monsters that have been unleashed. Clay asserts himself as leader and brings order to the knights from the chaos. He has his own book: the Book of the Knight's Code. They should all live by it.

programme.title: Awakening
programme.desc: When Mateo's comic creation, Z-Blob, follows him from a dream back to Brooklyn, Mateo and his sister realize the Dream World is real, and in danger!

programme.title: Dream Chasers
programme.desc: After a daring mission to save their friend in the Dream World, Mateo and Izzie find the nightmare has followed them back to the Waking World.

programme.title: Legacy, Vehicle and Mechs
programme.desc: Zane takes help from Nya for backup memories of their adventures to the Samurai X Cave computer, but Zane encounters a mysterious puzzle buried deep within his code. Nya digitizes Jay and uploads him into Zane's mind. Jay reviews memories of the Ninja's various motorcycles, mechs and planes in order to solve the vehicle-themed puzzle.

programme.title: The Jade Princess
programme.desc: In the wake of an assassination attempt targeting the royal family, the ninja invite the royal princess, HARUMI, into their makeshift family. Lloyd glimpses someone escaping over the rooftops with a sack on their back. Fearing it is the kidnapped princess, Lloyd takes up the chase! He discovers to his surprise, however, that the masked intruder is none other than the princess herself, who is not quite as docile or meek as she pretends. She has a habit of sneaking out of her chambers at night to feed the homeless who surround the Imperial Palace. This revelation only endears her to Lloyd more and Harumi and Lloyd quickly strike up a friendship. Unfortunately, trouble catches up to the ninja when the Sons Of Garmadon target the second Oni mask and attack the palace. The scope of the attack proves more than the Ninja were prepared for as the Sons of Garmadon detonate a series of subterranean bombs, bringing down part of the palace. Lloyd and Harumi escape onto the flying ship, DESTINY'S BOUNTY. But the victory is a pyrrhic one. The second Oni Mask has been stolen and Harumi's parents and Master Hutchins are feared lost.

programme.title: The Pranks
programme.desc: The friends are using their talents to pull a prank on Olivia. But who gets the last laugh? Stephanie finds the perfect front page story for the school paper! It's almost too good to be true. Emma and Andrea go undercover to solve the mystery of the two Jacobs.

programme.title: New Girl in Town
programme.desc: When the World Petacular comes to Heartlake City and is almost ruined before it's even started, five feisty girls unite, despite their differences, using their creativity to save the day. Best friends Olivia, Andrea, Emma, Mia and Stephanie reside in HeartLake City but didn't know each other - that is until the World Petacular brought them together! On the eve of the biggest event Heartlake City hosts, disaster and chaos is abound. New-in-town Olivia is helping her veterinarian Aunt Sophie with her mobile clinic. But when she's put in charge of training a scruffy puppy named Scarlet, the puppy runs amuck, leaving a trail of destruction as she collides with Andrea, ruins Emma's banner and Stephanie's cakes, and finally spooks Mia's horse Bella who bucks Mia off and sprints away. The girls quickly unite, helping each-other to save the day and most importantly have fun along the way!

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Royal Drum: No one believes Grandpa Smurf when he tells of far-away jungles and savannahs teeming with wild giant cats, striped horses, long-necked leaf-eaters and strange tribes... Only some Smurflings give some credit to his tales. But when Grandpa Smurf hears the sound of the magic Royal Drum in the forest, the one that can tame wild beasts, he sets out to prove that he's not an old addle-brained storyteller.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Kow-Tow, We Won't Bow: Smurfette leads the Smurflings on a nature hike, but Puppy gets too far ahead and they chase him into the land of the Wartmongers. King Bullrush captures them in bubbles and imprisons them. A group of rebels rescue the Smurflings and they escape on the back of Puppy.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - A Smurf On The Wild Side, Part I: What, or who, is that strange being in the forest? It looks vaguely like a Smurf, but it chatters away like the squirrel that seems to be accompanying it… And why is Papa Smurf talking about the Lost Smurfling?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Snappy's Puppet: Snappy has a new trick: he frightens everybody, or tries to, with his hand-puppet dragon. But it gets, shall we say, out of hand when Papa Smurf's magic liquid falls on the puppet and it comes alive. Alive and kicking, what's more, endangering Snappy...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - No Smurf Is An Island: Handy Smurf is the one who fixes everything that needs mending in the Village of the Smurfs. But are his efforts really appreciated by the other Smurfs? Not at all. At least this is what Handy feels when he resolves to leave the Smurfs Village forever and live in the sea with Marina the Mermaid...

programme.title: Farmer's Genie
programme.desc: As Farmer Smurf says, what's a gourd doing in the melon patch, when it should be by the rutabagas? But when Farmer Smurf pulls the gourd out of the ground he frees a genie, which calls him Master and insists on granting him wishes. The genie, called Gourdy, is going to be more of a hindrance than a help in his eagerness to please Farmer Smurf.

programme.title: Poet's Writers' Block
programme.desc: The Smurfs want a poem written for each of them. The pressure overwhelms Poet, so he runs away seeking inspiration. The Wilybeast King captures Poet and forces him to write a poem to cheer up the King's daughter. Poet learns that motivation must come from the heart and cannot be forced.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Crooner Smurf: Harmony Smurf is no longer wanted in the Smurf Choir: his singing is too far off-key. But Papa Smurf gives him an amulet that will make him a vocal virtuoso. Now here comes Hogatha...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Baby Smurf Is Missing: Thinking Baby Smurf is a leprechaun, two poachers kidnap him and try to get the small one to tell them where his pot of gold is hidden. Papa Smurf organizes everyone to attack the villains with Smurfberry pies so Baby can escape.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Smurfing Out Of Time: None of the Smurfs seem to have time to play with the Smurflings. They go on a visit to Father Time and come across the River of Time, the great current that flows along majestically, carrying with it all the time in the world. And then an accident occurs, with untimely consequences...

programme.title: Tailor's Magic Needle
programme.desc: Tailor Smurf has to make an outfit for every Smurf before the Fall fashion show. Brainy Smurf wants to help him and, using Papa Smurf's book of Magic, he conjures up a magic needle that sews ten times faster than tailor... But is it really any good?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Memory Melon: Selwyn and Tallulah are two powerful married wizards. The trouble is, they fight all the time. But the energy from their arguments is brewing up a dreadful storm and Papa has to get them to make up before the storm starts to rage.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - A Smurf For Denisa: Balthazar brings Denisa to Gargamel to baby-sit. But Gargamel loses Denisa in the wood and she and Sassette meet and become friends. Sassette and Denisa work together to free the Smurfs from Gargamel's stewpot, and prove you don't have to be big to be brave.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Peewit's Unscrupulous Adventure: Peewit, the court jester, is the Smurfs' human friend. There is to be a celebration at the King's castle and Peewit good-humouredly invites his little blue friends to the feast. But they learn that the wicked chamberlain is pilfering the King's possessions.

programme.title: The Smurfiest Of Friends
programme.desc: Brainy Smurf had one friend: Clumsy Smurf. But poor Clumsy is so, well, clumsy, that Brainy refuses to see him again. So now he is left without anyone willing to listen to him. Maybe Buddy, the good-looking imp met by chance near the Great Oak can be a pal for Brainy....

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Poltersmurf: There are few things Grandpa Smurf enjoys more than telling a good scary story, and there are few Smurfs who don't love to listen. But things get a little too much for Brainy Smurf when Grandpa tells of Poltersmurfs, and Poltersmurfs begin harrowing Brainy...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Greedy And The Porridge Pot: The good fairy, Guinilda gives Greedy a magic porridge pot that Brainy causes to overflow into the village and forest. The good-hearted fairy hurries to the rescue and then asks for the pot back to give to an orphanage of hungry children.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Most Unsmurfy Games: To prove the worth of his Big Book of Wilderness Survival, Brainy takes the Smurflings to the swamp. Where, thanks to his expert advice, the tiny group gets totally lost, is then caught in quicklime and trapped by King Bullrush of the Wartmongers. Fortunately, Bullrush is in a playful mood and devises a Smurf hunt. Unfortunately, Brainy believes he is a born leader...

programme.title: Smurf Box Derby
programme.desc: Handy Smurf makes another invention: the Smurfmobile. Each Smurf has his – or her – customized vehicle and all, or almost all, the Smurfs enjoy a little spin... But then the evil wizard Gargamel gets hold of the idea and starts making trouble for the Smurfs...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Noble Stag: His wicked cousin, Malcolm the Mean, who plans to kill him and mount him in his trophy room, has turned King Gerard into a black stag. The little Smurfs help their friend. When King Gerard is transformed back into his human form, Malcolm becomes imprisoned in the body of the stag.

programme.desc: Cowboys, cacti and dusty duels get the Rabbid treatment.

programme.title: S2 Bwah‑Brass Band
programme.desc: Noise, notes and musical mayhem as Rabbids attempt a band… badly.

programme.title: S2 Super Bwah‑Heroes

programme.title: S2 Creature Bwah‑niverse

programme.desc: Beasts, bugs and bizarre critters spark nonstop Rabbid mayhem.

programme.title: A Myth Full Of Grief And Despair About One Historical Error
programme.desc: Here is a boy called Arkasha who really doesn't like history lessons. The most frightening thing for him was…a history test. He tried his best to prepare for the test, however he fell asleep. When he opened his eyes he saw all the range of historic characters chastising him for his illiteracy, and Napoleon was even ready to hit him on the head with a globe! Arkasha was so scared that vowed to learn all the names and dates, otherwise how could he protect himself from such nervous historic creatures?!Do you know what children are scared the most of at school? What makes them tremble?!

programme.title: Panic Unbearable Legend About Insects
programme.desc: Once there was a girl called Anya who was very scared of insects! One day Anya's mother asked her to help around the house but in everything she did, Anya was haunted by spiders and all kinds of midges! She was on the edge of despair when her little brother proved to her, that little crumbs can't be of any danger to giants like children!

programme.title: Happy New Year… Again!
programme.desc: Masha decides celebrating New Year once is not enough and goes to mysterious China, where dragons dance, gardens bloom and many, many more interesting things are happening!

programme.title: Like Cat And Mouse
programme.desc: Alert! Bear's fridge is in danger! Someone has burst into his house to stay for life…but the Bear is ready for everything to defend his stocks! He calls for a savior, but in reality it turns to be a new intriguing story full of unexpected discoveries which leads Masha to some peculiar conclusions!

programme.title: At Your Service
programme.desc: The technologies some time can teach us a human lesson like in this story about two robots. One of them was presented to Masha for her birthday and the other one was made by the Bear to help him around, but tried to become the boss. Everything turned into great mess and only an unexpectedly awakened feeling between two robots put everything in its place.

programme.title: All You Need is a Goal
programme.desc: The ball is on the field, the players are in the field, the Bear in the chair is rooting for his favorite team. But Masha got bored in anticipation of a goal. Why wait when there is a team in the yard, and everyone needs a goal so much!

programme.title: Bon Appétit
programme.desc: Panda- the Bear's distant relative pays one more visit to the Bear. They start making Chinese dump-lings, but then Masha appears, with her own methods of cooking. And a simple cooking turns into a culinary master class with butterflies!

programme.title: Once In A Year
programme.desc: The Bear has his birthday party. All animals come to his place to congratulate him and give some presents. Seeing this Masha decides to prepare for her own birthday so none of the animals wouldn't have a chance to forget about her party and the list of presents.The Bear has his birthday party. All animals come to his place to congratulate him and give some presents. Seeing this Masha decides to prepare for her own birthday so none of the animals wouldn't have a chance to forget about her party and the list of presents.

programme.title: Prances With Wolves
programme.desc: The Wolves that live in the forest come with a plan to kidnap Masha and demand the Bear to pay a ransom. However the Bear is pleased to find Masha gone and he does not rush the events. Meanwhile Masha turns the Wolves' lives into a hell and they end up paying the ransom to the Bear just to get rid of her once and for all.

programme.title: Around the world in one day
programme.desc: The Bear is preparing to go on a world trip, but a last minute accident makes him panic. In the meantime, Masha knows the best way to prepare for the trip and shares it with the Bear.

programme.title: Princess and the Beast
programme.desc: Shocking and sensation! For the first time in our forest! A couple of tourists broke into the Bear's house without an invitation in search of impressions and cool photos. And there they are - just a sleepy Bear and Masha, who really wants to play. Rejoice tourists! You will have impressions, photos, and obstacle course from here and to the city itself!

programme.title: Tee For Three
programme.desc: How difficult it is to remain calm when two little tombs are raging in the house. Panda and Masha are fooling around for days. To cope with stress, Bear needs a good rest. Will he be able to restore internal forces or two fidgets will not give him peace?

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Masha is again playing mother and daughter with Rosie. But this time an honest lot distributed the roles. Now it's Masha's turn to put on her cap and get in the stroller. Will Rosie endure mother's everyday life?

programme.title: Terrible Power
programme.desc: The Female Bear presents Masha with a glamour magazine and now the Bear shall transform his house into a beauty salon. Get ready to learn a lesson that everything should be done with a sense of proportion, especially when it comes to beauty.

programme.title: All the world's a stage
programme.desc: The best remedy for boredom is a good game. And a good play is even better. That is exactly what our friends decided. It's just not so easy to agree on what kind of play to stage..

programme.title: The Tops and the Roots
programme.desc: There was a village and a man, living in this village. In a deep forest near that village, the Bear settled in. The Bear asked the man for some tasty treats. The man gave the Bear two options of what he prefers to eat: the tops or the roots. The Bear decided to take the tops. The man grew a turnip and gave the tops to the Bear. The tops were tasteless. The Bear asked the man to try the turnip. The man agreed on the condition that the Bear will help him with the housework and keep off the flies. While chasing away the flies, the Bear accidentally hit the man on the nose. The Bear was scared and ran away into the forest, grabbing the turnip with him. Since then, people use to say “to be a fool for one's pains”.

programme.title: Ali Baba
programme.desc: This story is about one very kind, but very poor Ali-Baba and his rich but greedy brother Kasym. Once upon a time Ali-Baba overheard the magic spell, which opens up the magic cape with numerous treasures. These treasures were stolen by the thieves and kept in this cave. One day Ali-Baba met Kasym and told him the secret spell. Kasym got inside the cape, but accidentally forgot the spell and the thieves caught him. They forced Kasym to learn the whole book of fairy tales by heart and spend one thousand days and a thousand and one nights telling these stories to them. This story teaches us to study well and avoid cheating.

programme.title: The Wolf and the Fox
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: Tom Thumb
programme.desc: This is a story about the small but brave boy. The moral of the story is that no matter how big and tall you are, you should not offend the little ones. It may happen so that you will meet some tom thumb boy, who will beat any “giant”.

programme.title: Wee Little Havroshechka
programme.desc: There lived a woman who had three daughters - two of her own and the stepdaughter called Wee Little Havroshechka. She loved her own daughters and hated the stepdaughter who was forced to work till dawn. No matter how hard she tried to please the stepmother, she was unapproachable. Once upon a time the stepmother kicked her out of the house, but every medal has its flipside – Wee Little Havroshechka met her Prince and they lived happily ever after, and it's all because she was hard-working and clean.

programme.title: Quartet Plus
programme.desc: To play in a quartet is not so easy as it seems, especially if there is no slack between musicians. This is what Masha tells Papa Bear, who came to visit. And he will tell about Bear's childhood and how he was mischievous with the Himalayan bear. Has anything changed since then? We will learn it from the new episode. And most importantly, music will unite everyone!

programme.title: Tour de Forest
programme.desc: Himalayan Bear is once again competing with Bear! This time they have arranged a bike race, but something doesn't smell right: Himalayan Bear intends on cheating to win! Good thing Masha stands as a guardian of justice and always comes to a friend's aid!

programme.title: What's Inside?
programme.desc: "What is inside such seemingly simple objects surrounding us? How are the mechanisms that we use every day arranged? Maybe they work with the help of magic? Or maybe each system has a certain order?In this episode, Masha decides to figure out how the objects surrounding her are arranged. And in the company of an old friend, this research becomes an adventure. "

programme.title: Try, Try Again
programme.desc: A van with Monkeys arrived at the Bear's house. They invite everyone to test themselves with the help of an attraction - a power meter. The Bear is confident that he will easily win the main prize. But things didn't go according to plan. And now the main strongman of the forest cannot do without the help of his friends.

programme.title: Princess and the Beast
programme.desc: Shocking and sensation! For the first time in our forest! A couple of tourists broke into the Bear's house without an invitation in search of impressions and cool photos. And there they are - just a sleepy Bear and Masha, who really wants to play. Rejoice tourists! You will have impressions, photos, and obstacle course from here and to the city itself!

programme.title: First Day Of School
programme.desc: With the beginning of September, Masha, like all the children wants to go to school and asks the Bear to make her one. Overwhelmed with enthu-siasm, the Bear completes the task and the next day Masha sits at a brand new desk and tries to act as an attentive student but ends up bringing the Bear to absolute madness.

programme.title: Fishy story
programme.desc: Summer is a time of rest and miracles. How nice is just to sit on the river bank with your best friends! However, everything is not so simple in our story. The Bear didn't even suspect what kind of adventure he was going to find on his fishing trip. While Masha and She-Bear frightened by his sudden disappearance, explore the neighborhood, he ... however, you will find out everything yourself in our new episode.

programme.title: Don't Wake Till Spring!
programme.desc: The autumn has arrived. The Bear prepares for his winter bedtime by barricading himself from Masha inside the house. But the little girl manages to find her way indoors and causes yet another mess by awakening a whole swarm of bees. But all her games eventually stop and when the Bear cooks some porridge to feed the child, he discovers her fallen asleep.

programme.title: A Ghost Story
programme.desc: At first time in her life Masha is frightened in earnest, however this creepy story shook up the whole forest and now hardly anyone can stay away from these strange scenes! And what would you do if your own pillow and blanket turn into real ghosts?! A real ghost story, oh yeah!

programme.title: The Very Fairy Tale
programme.desc: Masha loves fairy tales and of course she believes that each fairy tale should lead to happy end, even if nothing contributes to it! That's how the story goes… The Bear still hopes to win the heart of the female Bear. He finds an ancient gondola at the bottom of the forest lake. The Bear decides to restore it and invites the female Bear for a romantic ride! No one would have expected that this story would perfectly match Masha's new hobby - puppet theatre.

programme.title: Time To Ride My Pony
programme.desc: The Bear's good friend, the Tiger, is back for a visit and they decide to spend the time together in an intellectual way – playing chess. Masha is immediately drawn into the game and to everyone's surprise, she outsmarts and outplays both the Bear and his friend with just one chess figure.

programme.title: The Grand Piano Lesson
programme.desc: The bear finds a beautiful black piano in the forest. He happily takes it home, fixes and tunes it and begins to play some music. Masha couldn't help staying away from this lovely instrument. She decides to become a world famous pianist, she asks the Bear to teach her how to play the piano.

programme.title: Arts and Crafts Day
programme.desc: Masha announces Arts and Crafts Day. Get your glue, pencils and any unnecessary things and let's create! The Bear is trying to sneak away on a fishing trip. But what will he catch if all his floats are gone for crafts? Is it Masha, to put her in a corner? Well, not this time. Friendship always wins in our creative contests!

programme.title: The Foundling
programme.desc: Occasionally Masha finds an egg, from which a penguin hatches. The Bear has to take double care now. He cooks special dishes and builds mini aqua park for little penguin and Masha. Finally the Bear figures out that the penguin will be happy only in suitable weather conditions and send the penguin Antarctica on a little plane.

programme.title: See You Later
programme.desc: This day will change Bear's life forever. To everyone's surprise, Masha has suddenly grown up, getting all the forest dwellers shocked by her exceptionally good behavior. Her sister Dasha is going to take her back to the big city, which really upsets the Bear and others.

programme.title: Sleeping Beauties
programme.desc: Masha is the best "mommy" in the world, but even she can not put Rosy to sleep. Bear offers a solution: a music box. And everything would have been fine, but the music box suddenly turns out to hold a surprise inside it!

programme.title: We Come In Peace!
programme.desc: In the courtyard of the Bear's house a spaceship makes an emergency landing. The aliens need to urgently replenish their supplies and return home. Only on the ground everything is arranged differently than at home. Masha and Mishka will help them to understand what's what, fix the ship and go back to home.

programme.title: Scary Story About Spooky Stories
programme.desc: Are you sure that you really like spooky stories? What if this kind of story will get you really thrilled? Listen to one classic story and don't say that you are not shocked after all!

programme.title: Soul Freezing Tale Of Grim Forest And Tiny Timid Bug
programme.desc: All children are afraid of the dark. Masha was afraid of it too and had to sit with a torch all night long! But once upon a time she came up with the tale about a tiny bug, which lived in the woods and was so afraid of the dark, that every rustle made its heart tremble! The bug suffered a lot until he realized that all tiny things you see in the dark just seem to be frightful and fear makes no sense at all!

programme.title: Terrible Truth About Those Who Are Afraid To Be Little
programme.desc: Everyone think that it's so scary to be little as there are so many things are not accessible for you! But in reality there is no difference how little you are if there is someone who cares for you and someone you care about…

programme.title: Gloomy Story About The Darkest Dreams
programme.desc: All children are keen on computer games! Everyone likes to shoot a couple of monsters before going to sleep. Tolik also liked to play shooters until the monsters attack him in reality in order to commit the revenge! Or…was it just a dream? Let's see...

programme.title: Sinister Saga Of A Sick Tummy And A Girl Who Was Afraid Of Doctors
programme.desc: Masha narrates a terrific story about one little girl who was afraid of doctors. And once upon a time she experienced one fantastic story…she decided to cook dinner for her dolls. She took some clay and made “meat balls” with “semolina porridge”. As the meal seemed tasty, Sima decided to eat a bit of her dinner too… And so she lies in her bad and feels a horrible stomachache. Nobody knows how long she would need to suffer, but when she woke up…she realized herself in hospital…near the real snow queen… who explained that medical treatment is not scary at all…though some other things are very fearsome! Oh yeah!

programme.title: Bloodcurdling Saga About Joyful Event
programme.desc: Everyone think that it's so scary to be little as there are so many things are not accessible for you! But in reality there is no difference how little you are if there is someone who cares for you and someone you care about…

programme.title: Grim Parable About Superstitious Girl
programme.desc: Some people happen to believe in all sorts of omens like black cats, wearing clothes inside out, prophetic dreams… Poor girl Lucy believed in that kind of stuff so much that was even afraid to go outside to play with her friends. And how could you go out if you were born in the year of Purple rabbit that promises…no matter what… You'll see…

programme.title: Terrifying True Story About Monsters And Those Who Fear Them
programme.desc: Are you afraid of monsters? Sure you are! Let me tell you a scary story about a boy who experienced a real fear…This story happened on an abandoned tractor factory. The boy lost a scoop from his toy-tractor and decided to look for it at the factory. So he goes up the stairs and sees a large female monster, who was about to paint her lips with a roller! As he kept walking he noticed more monsters playing domino! The boy was very terrified and about to cry, when he learnt that it was just a movie set and all the monsters were not real! They were just actors…Finally the boy realized that all the monsters from the books and movies are not real at all! But if want to see a real monster- watch a fly under a microscope!

programme.title: The Wolf and the Fox
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

It is here that a group of marauding, merciless and bloodthirsty vampires, led by Marlow (Danny Huston), are coming. Their intention? A month long, uninterrupted feast of its helpless residents. It is up to Sheriff Eben (Josh Hartnett), his estranged wife, Stella (Melissa George), and an ever-shrinking group of survivors to do anything and everything they can to last till daylight.

programme.title: The Hitman's Apprentice
programme.desc: When 19-year-old Adam agrees to do a day's driving for his mum's gangster boyfriend Peter, it takes him on a 24-hour journey into a nightmarish world of murder, sex trafficking and revenge, in the company of aging hit man Roy.

programme.title: Adventures of a Taxi Driver
programme.desc: Joe likes the ladies and gets to meet a variety of them in his job as a taxi driver. From dizzy young women to frustrated housewives, Joe fancies them all, and they take a fancy to Joe. If only things were smoother at home for the put-upon cabbie. With his nagging mother, thieving teenage brother, and the attentions of an overbearing girlfriend with ideas of marriage, Joe leaves the homestead and rents the spare room at his best mate's flat. Meanwhile, he continues to find himself in an assortment of humorous sexual escapades until he accidentally becomes embroiled in a jewel heist that doesn't quite go to plan.

programme.title: Waiting for Anya
programme.desc: From the mind of world-renowned author Michael Morpurgo comes the cinematic adaptation of Waiting for Anya - a powerful and authentic true story of a young shepherd that had a key part to play in one of the world's most shocking moments in history. Based on the novel by the author of War Horse, Waiting for Anya follows the story of Jo Lalande, a thirteen-year-old shepherd living in the mountain village of Lescun. Though Europe may be ravaged by the horrors of World War II, Jo's world in the French Pyrenees has remained remarkably untouched. That is, until a ferocious encounter with a bear introduces Jo to the mysterious Benjamin, a Jewish refugee who is desperately awaiting the arrival of his missing daughter, Anya, before making his escape across the border. Making friends with Benjamin and his mother-in-law Horcada, an isolated widow who lives in the nearby mountains, Jo becomes aware of a very dangerous secret - the family are involved in smuggling Jewish children over the mountains to the safety of Spain. In a heroic act of defiance, Jo promises to assist Benjamin in his endeavours...but soon becomes embroiled in a perilous conspiracy when German troops make their descent upon the village. Filmed in the village of Lescun and the surrounding Aspe Valley, France in which the true to life story also originated, the film boasts an all-stellar cast including Noah Schnapp (Stranger Things), Academy Award Winner Anjelica Huston (Ever After, The Addams Family), Jean Reno (Leon, The Big Blue, Ronin), Frederick Schmidt (Mission: Impossible - Fallout), Thomas Kretschmann (The Pianist, Central Intelligence) and Nicholas Rowe (Riviera, Lock Stock and Two Smoking Barrels).

programme.title: Bernie
programme.desc: In small-town Texas, an affable mortician strikes up a friendship with a wealthy widow, though when she starts to become controlling, he goes to great lengths to separate himself from her grasp.

programme.title: Pyewacket
programme.desc: After her father dies, Leah is forced, by her unstable mother, to leave her friends behind and move to a house in the woods. Feeling isolated and hopeless, she turns to Black Magic to release her anger and naively performs an occult ritual to invoke the spirit of a witch to kill her mother.

programme.title: Honeydew
programme.desc: For Sam and Rylie an idyllic camping trip becomes an out of control nightmare. Seeking shelter on a local farm overnight when their car encounters trouble on the road, the couple find themselves at the mercy of an ageing farmer and her peculiar son.

programme.title: The Void
programme.desc: Enter this blood-soaked nightmare at your own risk. When police officer Carter happens upon a blood-soaked figure limping down a deserted road, he rushes the man to a hospital, only to discover a horrifying reality all linked to the mysterious hooded cult figures who are surrounding the hospital. Now Carter must lead the survivors on a hellish voyage in a bid to survive! Totally mind-bending!

programme.title: Blind
programme.desc: After losing her vision in a freak accident, former actress Faye is living alone in her dream home. Struggling to come to terms with her lost career and new life without sight, she soon gets the uneasy feeling that all is not right with her new world. But when a masked stranger shows up and moves in Faye soon begins to realise she is far from alone.

When daring young wizard Marek steals the final piece of the all-powerful Darkspore she embarks on a desperate quest to deliver the cursed artefact to the gods. But is caught in a death race between a ruthless team of elite mercenaries and a trinity of demons.

programme.title: Love's Portrait

She tracks the painting down to the post office it was sent from in Ireland. There she meets William and Saoirse, a brother-sister duo who run the post, and who offer her help and friendship on her quest. But William knows more than he's letting on. programme.title: Please dont Date Him
programme.desc: Home appliance developer Seo Jisung dreams of an easy life like a welldesigned algorithm. The “smart voice recognition AI refrigerator” she is in the process of developing accidentally gets combined with an antiterrorism super sensor chip that went missing from the National Intelligence Service Korea. Her refrigerator that couldn't even determine whether an ingredient was rotten suddenly identifies human lowlifes without even needing her to tell it to. This leads to revealing the truth about Jisung's fiancé. The man she thought of as an elite was actually a criminal. At the perfect timing, Jung Gukhee, a firefighter that seems too good to be true shows up in her life.

programme.title: Dharmakshetra
